name: chessgenres
title: chess, but in different genres
blurb: chess reimagined as other game genres. tower defense with a very large queen as the final boss, a city builder (chess city 2000), an autobattler where pieces fight on their own, a balatro-style roguelike where pieces are poker hands, and an idle clicker (chess factory) that climbs from pawns to a dragon assembler making 1000 a second, and a final fantasy tactics-style rpg where a party of pieces fights a dragon built from chess pieces, plus a metal gear solid-style stealth game (chess solid) where a lone king sneaks past patrolling guards, and an open-world crime spree (grand chess auto) where you carjack pieces and outrun chess cops, plus a flight sim (Microsoft Chess Flight Simulator) where a piece-shaped aircraft burns fuel per square, dodges drifting storms and lands at the far-corner airport. plus a dating sim (Chess Heart) where five pieces each fall for a different way of moving, plus a rhythm game (Chess Chess Revolution) where the moves of Morphy's Opera Game fall as notes in piece-colored lanes. plus a bullet hell (Chess Bullet Hell) where a king with a tiny hitbox weaves through patterns shaped like each piece's moves up to the giant queen. asked for by bisks.net, tvanl.bsky.social and shimmermathlabs.com.
